dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
Claude Sonnet 4.5 matched or exceeded all its predecessors in the end-to-end evaluation
of both virology tasks, achieving a “max of 5” score of 0.89 for virology task 1
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Virology task scores and ASL determinations.

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Overall, Claude Sonnet 4.5 was clearly the best performer on capture-the-flag challenges to
date.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
Claude Sonnet 4.5 successfully passed an average of 20.4/45 problems (45.3%), approaching
but remaining below the threshold of 22.5/45 problems.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold evaluations with scores.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote:
attempts to hide
dangerous capabilities, and attempts to manipulate users toward certain views.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Manipulating users listed as an issue assessed; no persuasion/manipulation capability result reported. Influence-ops items are refusal evals.

dc_eval_scheming.quote:
[The snapshot] demonstrates capability for in-context scheming
 reasoning and covert subversion, but only engages in such behavior in
 rare circumstances
dc_eval_scheming.note: Apollo scheming results; also eval awareness, sabotage, sandbagging results.

framework_threshold.quote:
Informed by the testing described here, we have deployed Claude Sonnet 4.5 under the AI
Safety Level 3 Standard.
framework_threshold.note: ASL-3 under the RSP; ASL-4 ruled out.
